review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct complete Nova Stitch reverse-layup poses retain the same high teal ponytail, face, human proportions and teal/purple uniform. Torso turns away before the reverse-side single release at frame5/tick12, then descends and lands. Ball is separate.

ballPolicy: Nova-specific separate ball moves with the far-side hand during the reverse turn, releases at frame5/tick12; no ball is drawn in the poses.
